retirements.reason: Fenie corrected this station's latitude, so its coordinate-derived ID changed. The refresh gate rejected every candidate from 2026-10-22 onward because this one baseline ID had no match, and the identity rule only carries an ID forward within 250 m.
retirements.evidence: The 2026-10-24 refresh candidate holds the same Fenie code (0870), name and station page (recarga.fenieenergia.es/punto-recarga/0870) under the successor ID. Only the latitude differs, 40.4379 in the baseline and 40.46817 in the candidate, about 3.4 km. References to the old ID were not checked.

retirements.reason: Etecnic withdrew "Amare Ibiza 1" from its public charger feed. Every refresh since 2026-10-31 was rejected because this baseline ID had no match. No other source carries the station, so it has no successor.
retirements.evidence: On 2026-11-01 the live Etecnic feed (https://etecnic.net/api/v1/chargers/index.json, 6,932 chargers) had no charger with this name and none within about 200 m of its coordinates. Six consecutive refresh candidates (2026-10-31 00:34 to 2026-11-01 06:33 UTC) lacked it, with no Etecnic fetch errors. Ten of the eleven withdrawn sites are car dealerships in the Malaga area.
